title: Senior IAM Architect – Saviynt & Microsoft Entra ID
description:
Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced
**Senior IAM Architect**
with strong expertise in
**Saviynt Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)**
to lead the design, architecture, implementation, and optimization of enterprise Identity and Access Management solutions.

The ideal candidate should have extensive experience in architecting enterprise-scale IAM solutions, developing identity governance frameworks, implementing access management strategies, and integrating complex enterprise applications. The role requires strong technical ownership, architectural decision-making capabilities, and the ability to independently drive IAM transformation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

**1. IAM Architecture & Solution Design**

* Lead the architecture and design of enterprise-wide Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions.
* Define IAM strategies, reference architectures, technical roadmaps, and implementation standards.
* Design scalable, secure, and resilient identity governance and access management solutions.
* Drive IAM modernization and transformation initiatives across enterprise environments.
* Provide architectural guidance and technical leadership to IAM engineering and implementation teams.

**2. Saviynt – Identity Governance & Administration (IGA)**

* Lead the implementation, configuration, and architecture of Saviynt IGA solutions.
* Design and implement identity lifecycle management, including Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
* Configure access certifications, access reviews, segregation of duties (SoD), and access request workflows.
* Develop and manage application onboarding, role management, entitlement management, and provisioning workflows.
* Design integrations between Saviynt and enterprise applications, directories, and HR systems.
* Troubleshoot complex integration, provisioning, and governance-related issues.

**3. Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)**

* Architect and implement Microsoft Entra ID solutions for enterprise identity and access management.
* Design and manage Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Conditional Access, and Identity Protection.
* Implement identity federation, authentication protocols, and access management policies.
* Configure and manage Privileged Identity Management (PIM) and Privileged Access Management (PAM) capabilities.
* Design hybrid identity solutions integrating on-premises Active Directory with Microsoft Entra ID.
* Implement secure identity integrations using SAML, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and SCIM.

**4. Integration & Security**

* Architect integrations between Saviynt, Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, HR platforms, and enterprise applications.
* Establish identity governance and access control frameworks aligned with enterprise security requirements.
* Drive Zero Trust identity security initiatives.
* Ensure compliance with security standards, audit requirements, and regulatory frameworks.
* Identify IAM security gaps and recommend architectural improvements.

**5. Technical Leadership**

* Own end-to-end technical delivery of IAM architecture and implementation initiatives.
* Collaborate with security architects, infrastructure teams, application owners, and business stakeholders.
* Review technical designs, implementation plans, and integration approaches.
* Mentor engineering teams and provide technical direction.
* Lead architecture discussions, solution reviews, and technical workshops.

Required Technical Skills

* Strong hands-on and architectural experience in
  **Saviynt IGA**
  .
* Extensive experience with
  **Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)**
  .
* Enterprise IAM architecture and implementation.
* Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).
* Identity Lifecycle Management (JML).
* Access Certification and Access Reviews.
* Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC).
* Segregation of Duties (SoD).
* Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA).
* Privileged Identity Management (PIM).
* Active Directory and Azure AD / Entra ID integration.
* SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect and SCIM.
* Application onboarding and identity provisioning.
* IAM automation and integration capabilities.

Experience & Qualifications

* 10–15 years of overall experience in Identity and Access Management, Information Security, or related domains.
* Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise IAM architecture and solution design.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Saviynt IGA implementations.
* Proven experience architecting and implementing Microsoft Entra ID solutions.
* Experience leading large-scale enterprise IAM transformation and integration projects.
* Strong stakeholder management, technical communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Relevant Saviynt or Microsoft security certifications will be an added advantage.

Preferred Certifications

* Saviynt Certified Professional (where applicable).
* Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate.
* Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert.
* Relevant IAM or Information Security certifications.

title: Junior Consultant (IT) (m/w/d)
description:

* Nachvollziehbare Dokumentation der Ergebnisse und Aufbereitung für die Abstimmung mit Mandanten und Projektteam

* Erste Berührungspunkte mit Compliance, IT-Prüfung, Informationssicherheit oder internen Kontrollsystemen

* Erste praktische Erfahrungen in IT, Beratung, Prüfung oder im Finanzumfeld, z. B. durch Praktika, eine Werkstudententätigkeit oder Berufspraxis

**Darauf Kannst Du Dich Bei Ypsilon Freuen**

* Attraktive Vergütung
* Homeoffice, faire Überstundenregelung und keine Kernarbeitszeiten
* 29 Urlaubstage, zusätzlich einen weiteren Tag für Heiligabend und Silvester
* Umfassendes Onboarding
* Betriebliche Krankenversicherung
* Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und vermögenswirksame Leistungen
* Job-Ticket und Fahrrad-Leasing
* Monatlicher Sachbezug (bis zu 50 €)
* Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
* Corporate Benefits (Vorteilsportal für Mitarbeiterangebote)
* Moderne IT-Systeme und optimale ÖPNV-Anbindung
* Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege

Über uns
  
  
Als unabhängige, partnergeführte Beratungseinheit sind wir als
**Ypsilon**
weltweit tätig und bringen erfolgreiche Unternehmen voran. Egal ob Steuerberatung, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder Rechtsberatung: An unseren sieben Standorten in Berlin, Düsseldorf, Hamburg, Köln, München, Rahden und Wuppertal bieten unsere Mitarbeiter:innen passende Lösungen für Unternehmenskunden unterschiedlicher Branchen und Rechtsformen.
  
  
Bei
**Ypsilon**

Verwirkliche mit uns Deine Ziele und werde Teil der attraktiven Ypsilon Arbeitswelt!

title: Vice President, Specialist Risk Technology, Technoogy and Operations
description:
**Business Function**
Technology and Operations (T&O) enables and empowers the bank with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and innovation. In Group T&O, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple banking delivery channels.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
This is to manage risks for LOBTs acting as Line 1 risk manager
  
  
**Key Accountabilities:**

* Assist Line of Business Technology in managing technology and operational risks
* Drive and ensure regulatory compliance for the LOBT
* Liaise and co-ordinate audit activities involving the LOBT
* Issue & Action management for LOBT including is impacted (across external and internal audits and reviews and excluding IT Information Security) and action planning.
* Engagement across Technology verticals, Operations, Business, Compliance to prioritize, plan, act, prove, close all open findings within committed timelines.
* Scan regulatory requirements, circulars to ensure forward planning and execution for compliance. This includes Singapore and India regulatory requirements.
* Prepare, maintain and conduct control testing for units Risk Control Self Assessments (RCSAs)
* Outsourcing Risk assessment for the LOBT
* Monitor risk issues and incidents for LOBT.

**Job Duties & responsibilities:**

* Liaise with stakeholders within and outside DBS, including at Group level to have a comprehensive view of all Technology Risks.
* Engage with Technology verticals and others as appropriate within DBS, to progress on closure of all open points.
* Engage with Compliance, understand the regulatory requirements at country and group level, and add these to the action points which Technology must ensure.
* Early identification of execution challenges in risk mitigation actions and being an effective catalyst with Technology teams and seniors to resolve bottlenecks such as cost or resource approvals, conflicting priorities.
* Risk assessment for LOBT covering partners, external environment and identify potential risks such as relating to scale-preparedness, DR & BCP support for the organization, code quality in terms of testing and deployment governance.
* Regular updates as per agreed rhythm, and fronting dialogues with stakeholders/LOBT, to highlight process on Risk Management and Risk Mitigation.
* Liaise with relevant departments to ensure awareness of Technology Risk within the DBS India Technology Team, and partner for this awareness across DBS India.
* Liase with Line of Business Risk in the region and co-ordinate efforts for the LOBT landscape used by India.

**Requirements**

* Ideally, 14+ years of successful experience in Technology Risk Management, Information Security, Technology Audit.

**Education / Preferred Qualifications:**

* Ideally, risk-accreditations like CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP experience on Information System audits and remediation, Agile Scrum accreditation and/or experience, and has worked as a Lead Auditor in Information System audits including ISO audits.
* Minimum Computer Science or Technology Management graduate, preferably in Info-Sec specialization.

**Core Competencies:**

* Awareness of Information Systems and their complexity, potential points of failure from a risk perspective.
* Good communication skills and ability to manage dialogues with seniors.
* Readiness to raise the “red flag” for risks, in the interests of the bank.

**Technical Competencies**

* Ideally, risk-accreditations like CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP experience on Information System audits and remediation, Agile Scrum accreditation and/or experience, and has worked as a Lead Auditor in Information System audits including ISO audits.

**Work Relationship**

* Awareness of Information Systems and their complexity, potential points of failure from a risk perspective.

**DBS India - Culture & Behaviours**

* Drive Performance Through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure Customer Focus by Delighting Customers & Reduce Complaints
* Build Pride and Passion to Protect, Maintain and Enhance DBS’ Reputation
* Enhance Knowledge Base, Build Skill Sets & Develop Competencies
* Invest in Team Building & Motivation through Ideation & Innovation
* Execute at Speed While Maintaining Error Free Operations
* Develop a Passion for Performance to Grow Talent Pool
* Maintain the Highest Standards of Honesty and Integrity

**Location:**
I-Think Techno, Kanjurmarg
  
  
**Job:**
Technology
  
  
**Schedule:**
Regular
  
  
**Employee Status:**
Full time
